title: Twinkle Francis
text:
Hey there! I’m Twinkle.
Powered by coffee, curiosity, and a love for technology, I’m currently pursuing my Master of Data Science at UBC. Before this adventure, I worked as a DevOps Engineer in India. I enjoy building things, asking way too many “why?” questions, and turning data into meaningful insights. I’m on a quest to level up my data science skills, build impactful projects, and have some fun along the way.
To learn more about Quarto websites visit https://quarto.org/docs/websites.

title: My First Weeks in MDS
text:
Me before MDS: “I’ve got this.”
Me after Week 2: “Who invited Git, Quarto, Bash, Python, R and five deadlines to the same party?” 😭
I knew MDS would be challenging, but I didn’t expect it to hit the gas pedal on day one. Somewhere between orientation and my first assignment, I realized that “I’ll catch up tomorrow” is a dangerous sentence.
The funny part? Every time I think I’ve finally figured something out, the course casually introduces three new things I’ve never heard of before. It’s a constant cycle of confusion, Googling, tiny victories, and celebrating because my terminal finally stopped yelling at me.
Would I choose this chaos again? Absolutely. Ask me again during quiz week… and the answer might depend on how much coffee I’ve had. ☕😄



My first days at UBC.

title: About
text:
🧠 Why Data Science?
For me, data science is where curiosity meets creativity. I love understanding how things work, asking way too many “why?” questions, and turning messy information into meaningful insights. What excites me most is that there’s always something new to learn—whether it’s a machine learning model, a visualization technique, or a completely different way of thinking about a problem. I enjoy building things that are both useful and a little bit c🕶️l.

title: About
text:
🎈 Fun Facts

🤖 I’ll happily spend hours exploring new AI tools just to see what they’re capable of.
🧩 I enjoy solving puzzles — whether they’re coding bugs or everyday problems.
🌎 Moving from India to Canada for MDS has been one of the biggest adventures of my life.
☕ I’ve accepted that every “five-minute fix” in programming has a mysterious way of becoming a two-hour adventure.

title: About
text:
🎯 Current Mission
Survive MDS one milestone at a time, build projects that make me proud, and graduate with a portfolio that reflects both my technical skills and my curiosity. Bonus points if I can have some fun along the way. 🚀
